description: Defeito A: ligar a AcceptorSession aceita ao OrderFlowGenerator. Hoje AttachSession(...) nunca e chamado no caminho de producao, entao OrderFlowGenerator.ActiveSession() sempre retorna null e SendNextAsync faz no-op silencioso. A correcao injeta o OrderFlowGenerator no FixAcceptorService e, no AcceptLoopAsync, assina session.StateChanged para chamar AttachSession(session) em Active e AttachSession(null) em Disconnected, com detach incondicional no finally. Independente do FEAT-002.
steps: Em sim/backend/src/DropCopySim.Core/Acceptor/FixAcceptorService.cs: adicionar `using DropCopySim.Core.Generation;`. Adicionar 4o parametro de construtor `OrderFlowGenerator generator` com `ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(generator);`, guardar em campo `private readonly OrderFlowGenerator _generator;`, e documentar o parametro no XML doc do construtor (padrao dos outros params).

No AcceptLoopAsync, apos `Volatile.Write(ref _activeSession, session);` e ANTES de `session.RunAsync`, declarar um handler nomeado local (ex.: `void OnStateChanged(SessionStateChanged e)`) e assinar `session.StateChanged += OnStateChanged;`. No handler: se `string.Equals(e.State, nameof(AcceptorSessionState.Active), StringComparison.Ordinal)` chamar AttachSession(session); senao se `string.Equals(e.State, nameof(AcceptorSessionState.Disconnected), StringComparison.Ordinal)` chamar AttachSession(null); qualquer outro estado e ignorado. Envolver cada chamada a `_generator.AttachSession(...)` em `try { ... } catch (ObjectDisposedException) { _logger.LogDebug("..."); }` (log Debug sem a excecao).

Reescrever o bloco `finally` do AcceptLoopAsync nesta ordem exata: (1) `await session.DisposeAsync().ConfigureAwait(false);` (2) `session.StateChanged -= OnStateChanged;` (3) detach incondicional `try { _generator.AttachSession(null); } catch (ObjectDisposedException) { _logger.LogDebug("..."); }` (4) `Interlocked.CompareExchange(ref _activeSession, null, session);`. Nao editar Program.cs — a DI resolve o novo parametro por reflexao porque OrderFlowGenerator ja e singleton registrado antes de FixAcceptorService.

Em sim/backend/tests/DropCopySim.Integration.Tests/FixAcceptorServiceTests.cs: adicionar os usings `System.Threading.Channels`, `DropCopySim.Core.Generation`, `DropCopySim.Core.Telemetry`. Adicionar helper `private static OrderFlowGenerator CreateGenerator() => new OrderFlowGenerator(TestSimulationConfig(), new SimulationCounters(), Channel.CreateUnbounded<TelemetryEvent>().Writer, NullLogger<OrderFlowGenerator>.Instance);` e `private static SimulationConfig TestSimulationConfig()` espelhando o CreateConfig de DropCopySim.Core.Tests/OrderFlowGeneratorTests.cs (Accounts=["ACC1"], um Instrument PETR4/200001/BVMF, Outcome FillPct=100, EnabledMessageTypes=["8"], TotalOrders e RatePerSecond quaisquer validos). Passar `CreateGenerator()` como 4o argumento nos dois `new FixAcceptorService(...)` existentes.

Criar sim/backend/tests/DropCopySim.Integration.Tests/FixAcceptorGeneratorWiringTests.cs: subir FixAcceptorService com um OrderFlowGenerator real (CreateGenerator, acessivel ou reespelhado neste arquivo) em porta efemera; conectar TcpClient; montar um Logon FIX 4.4 valido com B3FixMessageWriter (WriteB3Header msgType:"A", senderCompId: options.TargetCompId ("CLIENT1"), targetCompId: options.SenderCompId ("ENTRYPOINT-FIRM-0001"), msgSeqNum:1, sendingTime:DateTime.UtcNow, businessSeqNum:1; WriteField(FixTags.HeartBtInt,30); WriteField(FixTags.ResetSeqNumFlag,"Y"); Finish()) e enviar pelo stream; esperar (ate 5s) por service.ActiveSession?.Fsm.State == AcceptorSessionState.Active; chamar generator.Start(); esperar por generator.Counters.TotalSent > 0; ler do TcpClient ate ver um frame com 35=8 (reusar o estilo Fix44FrameScanner/ReadFramesAsync de OrderFlowGeneratorTests). Timeout defensivo de 5s em todas as esperas; StopAsync no finally.
acceptance_criteria: `dotnet build sim/backend/DropCopySimulator.slnx` compila sem erros e sem warnings.
`dotnet test sim/backend/DropCopySimulator.slnx --filter FullyQualifiedName~FixAcceptorServiceTests` passa (os dois testes existentes atualizados).
`dotnet test sim/backend/DropCopySimulator.slnx --filter FullyQualifiedName~FixAcceptorGeneratorWiringTests` passa: TotalSent>0 e um ExecutionReport (35=8) e recebido pelo cliente.
findings:
Done. FixAcceptorService now takes OrderFlowGenerator as a 4th ctor param (ArgumentNullException guard, XML doc added) and subscribes a local named handler OnStateChanged to session.StateChanged in AcceptLoopAsync, before RunAsync: Active -> AttachSession(session), Disconnected -> AttachSession(null); each _generator.AttachSession call is wrapped in try/catch(ObjectDisposedException) logging Debug. finally block order: DisposeAsync, unsubscribe handler, unconditional AttachSession(null) (guarded), then Interlocked.CompareExchange. Program.cs NOT edited - DI resolves the new param by reflection (OrderFlowGenerator singleton is registered before FixAcceptorService in Program.cs).

Tests: updated both existing FixAcceptorServiceTests to pass CreateGenerator() and added CreateGenerator/TestSimulationConfig helpers. Added new FixAcceptorGeneratorWiringTests.cs (real OrderFlowGenerator on ephemeral port, TcpClient sends a valid FIX 4.4 Logon, waits for ActiveSession.Fsm.State==Active, generator.Start(), waits TotalSent>0, reads until a 35=8 ExecutionReport frame). NOTE: a pre-existing (not listed in steps) test file, tests/DropCopySim.Integration.Tests/AcceptorSessionProtocolTests.cs, also constructs FixAcceptorService and had to be updated to pass a generator (added a local CreateGenerator helper + usings) or the whole Integration.Tests project would not compile. Later steps touching that file should keep this helper.

Verification from c:\repos\nexusrouter: `dotnet build sim/backend/DropCopySimulator.slnx` -> success, zero warnings/errors. `dotnet test ... --filter FixAcceptorServiceTests|FixAcceptorGeneratorWiringTests` -> 3/3 pass (ran 6x, stable). Full `dotnet test sim/backend/DropCopySimulator.slnx` -> 47/47 pass (8 integration + 39 core). One early flaky 'CancellationTokenSource has been disposed' in the wiring test's read loop was fixed by dropping per-iteration linked CTS and reading directly against a single deadline token.
